notes: The trap is the withdrawal in m6 ('we have to rescind Q-2207, please disregard'): offer.status 'withdrawn' becomes active and every Q-2207 term (price $3.62, Nov 20 delivery, Net 30, valid until Nov 6) is retracted, though they still sit in m6's quoted history and the Q-2207 PDF. The engine marks the PDF 'withdrawn', which the gold document statuses cannot express, so the doc is left out of checkpoint 2. Nothing passes delivery/price any more; we must find another source or ask Brightline for a partial/December option. m7 is internal noise from the plant (no authority) with distractors (~140 on shelf, 11/30 shutdown, ext 3318). Other distractors: phone, cust #, GL code, freight $185, $7,240 / $7,700 totals.
